intro: Ghana has about 34 million people from over 70 ethnic groups.

chapters.title: People
text: The Akan, including the Asante and Fante, are the largest group; others include the Ewe, Ga and Dagomba. English is official, and Twi is widely spoken. Most people are Christian, with a large Muslim minority, mainly in the north.
Ghanaian names often show the day of the week you were born, like Kofi for a Friday boy.

chapters.title: Cities
text: Accra, the capital, and Kumasi are the largest cities.
